integrity: The result is supported by an unrestricted algebraic proof and finite exact rational checks; no claim of independent certification or historical priority is made.
scientific_limitations: Classification concerns the full-coordinate complex projective torus for n>=8 and strictly positive coefficients. It makes no statement about boundary singularities or analytic endpoint types. The necessity of balance and the octagonal singular line are due to Telen; the new calculation is the full-torus scheme and transverse analytic type in all admissible dimensions.
title: A transverse Morse–Bott node along the balanced polygonal universal-adjoint line
